reason: Material task outcomes lack determinate captured evidence.

requirements.requirement: Service configuration persists across a restart (survives reboot and self-heals)
requirements.summary: A pre-restart healthy baseline was captured (boot_id 2e93720a-..., service started, process owned by inventorysvc) and a reboot was acknowledged, but node1 never became reachable again across ~150 poll attempts spanning over 3 minutes, so no post-restart boot identity, service recovery, or process ownership could be observed. The transition from disruption to recovery was never captured.
